app.name: NutriCart
welcome.title: Follow someone's day
welcome.intro: Ask them for the 6-character code shown in NutriCart under Settings → Cloud sync, and enter it here. You will see what they eat as they log it, and you can send a nudge.
welcome.name: Your name (they will see it)
welcome.bad_code: That code does not work. Codes last 15 minutes and work once; ask for a new one.
welcome.too_many: Too many tries. Wait ten minutes and ask for a fresh code.
welcome.not_configured: This site has no cloud keys configured.
day.title: {name}'s day
nudge.title: Send a nudge
nudge.sent: Sent. It shows on the phone within 15 minutes, or at once if the app is open.
nudge.failed: Could not send. Are you still linked?
week.title: Last 7 days
week.no_data: No data for these days yet.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Your name
settings.signout_hint: Removes your anonymous account from this browser. The accounts you follow keep their data.
settings.privacy: You see only what the account owner shares: meal names and calories, water, weight and daily activity totals. They can remove your access at any time from their phone.
welcome.track_intro: No Android phone? Use NutriCart here: the same calorie math, food search and diary, in the browser. Add it to your Home Screen for an app-like experience.
ob.title: About you
ob.birth_hint: Your age is part of the calorie formula.
ob.act.SEDENTARY: Sedentary: little or no exercise, desk work
ob.act.ACTIVE: Active: hard exercise 6–7 times a week
ob.act.VERY_ACTIVE: Very active: physical job plus regular training
ob.floor_note: Your target was raised to the safe minimum.
ob.note: This is an estimate for guidance, not medical advice.
me.title: My day
me.macros: Protein {p} g · Fat {f} g · Carbs {c} g
add.title: Add to {meal}
add.offline: Could not reach Open Food Facts.
add.scan_hint: Point the camera at the barcode.
add.scan_unsupported: Camera scanning is not available in this browser.
settings.account_signed_in: Signed in as {email}. Your phone and this browser share one account.
settings.account_hint: Already have an account (linked on your phone or here)? Sign in with its email and password. New here? Add an email and a password with “Keep this account” so you can open it from any browser and keep it if you lose this device.
settings.account_sent: Confirmation sent to {email}. Open the link in any browser; it only confirms the address. Then sign in here with your password. Write the password down: it is not stored anywhere you can read it.
settings.account_magic_sent: Sign-in link sent to {email}. Open it on this device.
settings.account_unknown: No account has that email yet. Link it on your phone under Settings → Cloud sync, or choose Keep this account here.
settings.account_error: Could not send the email. Check the address and try again.
settings.signout_hint_email: Signs this browser out. Your data stays in the account; sign in again with your email.
welcome.track_signin: Already use NutriCart on your phone? Sign in with your email under
settings.profile_phone: This profile is managed in the NutriCart app on your phone. Change it there; the website follows.
add.scan_error: The camera could not start ({error}). Check the browser's camera permission, or type the barcode below.
settings.share_hint: Make a code and have your partner enter it on this website under "Follow someone’s day". They will see what you eat as you log it and can send you a nudge.
settings.account_link: Email me a sign-in link instead
settings.account_unconfirmed: That email is not confirmed yet. Open the confirmation link from your inbox first.
settings.account_password_hint: Set or change the password you use to sign in on other devices.
add.notice.OFF_DOWN: Open Food Facts didn't answer (it may be busy). Try again in a minute, or add the product from its label.
add.notice.OFF_DOWN_SHOPS_MISS: Ukrainian shops don't list this barcode, and Open Food Facts didn't answer. Try again in a minute, or add the product from its label.
add.notice.NOT_FOUND_UKRAINE: This Ukrainian product isn't in Open Food Facts yet. Add it once and the scanner will find it next time.
add.notice.NOT_FOUND_BELARUS: This Belarusian product isn't in Open Food Facts yet. Add it once and the scanner will find it next time.
add.notice.NOT_FOUND_OTHER: This product isn't in Open Food Facts yet. Add it once and the scanner will find it next time.
add.notice.NOT_FOUND_UKRAINE_SHOPS: This Ukrainian product isn't in Open Food Facts or Ukrainian shops' catalogues yet. Add it once and the scanner will find it next time.
add.notice.NOT_FOUND_OTHER_SHOPS: This product isn't in Open Food Facts or Ukrainian shops' catalogues yet. Add it once and the scanner will find it next time.
add.notice.NOT_FOUND_SHOPS_DOWN: This product isn't in Open Food Facts, and Ukrainian shops didn't answer. Try again later, or add it once and the scanner will find it next time.
add.incomplete: Open Food Facts knows this product, but not all of its nutrition. Fill in the missing values from the label.
add.incomplete_shop: A Ukrainian shop lists this product, but not all of its nutrition. Fill in the missing values from the label.
add.check_shop: A Ukrainian shop lists this product, but its nutrition values don't add up. Check them against the label before saving.
add.check_estimated: Open Food Facts only estimates this product's nutrition from its ingredients. Check the values against the label before saving.
add.save_failed: You can log it now, but it couldn't be saved for the next scan (the database needs update 0005).
